title: Object: one default view, ready to merge

owner_note.text: Every object now draws as one row (icon, id, class, counts) that opens to its data and updates live, and object() and inspect() are folded into it. You can step through it at /framework/core/Item/watch/ on the default-view server. It's reviewed and ready to merge on worktree/default-view, but not merged.
